product_metadata.title: VOGOL 84 Inch Long Sheer Curtains, Semi Sheer Botanical Curtain Draperies for Living Room Bedroom, Grey Birds & Flowers Printed Window Treatment with Rod Pocket, 1 Panel
features: SET MADE: You will find 1 panel animals & flowers printed sheer curtain in package. Panel measures 52W x 84L.

Vibrant design: Natural bird and flower patterns are designed to give a sense of comfort. The classic patterns have an aesthetic look that gives any space an elegant and chic appearance that perfectly matches any interior home decor style.
LIGHT FILTERING: Premium soft touch feeling on these elegant cotton blend materials, add a refreshing charm to your window and lets in beautiful diffused light, yet provide privacy protection.

SERVE WELL: Sheer enough to let lots of light through but patterned to provide quite a bit of privacy. A perfect enhancement to your living room, bedroom, family room, dining room, bathroom, office, or any other window space that could use. You can pair these curtains with other VOGOL blackout curtain panels to complete a stylish layered look.
EASY TO CARE: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low, light iron as needed.
